plans.idea: Product-forward story: brand and headline on top, the Solstice bottle (via a large minor slot) as the big centered focal image, the CTA directly under it, and the violet glow kept as a small mood swatch closing the column.

Vertical take on the original split: logo and a full-width headline block up top, then the violet glow panel and the bottle as matched squares side by side, with a wide centered CTA anchoring the bottom.
Image-first poster: the violet glow fills the top half as the atmosphere, then a left-aligned brand/headline/CTA column on the bottom half sits beside the bottle, which acts as the product callout.
